mapper.select: SELECT b.bal_ym AS month,b.bgn_bal_amt AS amount,b.end_bal_amt AS closing,b.min_oprt_fund_amt AS minimum, b.init_yn AS initial,c.cls_stts_cd AS status FROM fin.cash_bal b LEFT JOIN fin.mth_cls c ON c.cls_ym=b.bal_ym WHERE b.init_yn='Y'

SELECT COALESCE(c.cls_ym,b.bal_ym) AS month,b.bgn_bal_amt AS amount,b.end_bal_amt AS closing,b.min_oprt_fund_amt AS minimum, b.init_yn AS initial,c.cls_stts_cd AS status FROM fin.mth_cls c FULL JOIN fin.cash_bal b ON c.cls_ym=b.bal_ym
SELECT cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_ym=#{month}
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE fin.cash_bal IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin.cash_bal(bal_ym,bgn_bal_amt,init_yn,updated_by,updated_at) VALUES(#{input.month},#{input.amount},'Y',#{actor},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT(bal_ym) DO UPDATE SET bgn_bal_amt=EXCLUDED.bgn_bal_amt,init_yn='Y',updated_by=EXCLUDED.updated_by,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.sql: inflw_id,to_char(COALESCE(inflw_plan_dt,rcpt_dt),'YYYY-MM') AS month,inflw_amt AS amount,inflw_se_cd,inflw_item_nm,inflw_plan_dt AS planned_date,rcpt_dt AS actual_date,rmrk_desc AS remark
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fin.etc_inflw ORDER BY COALESCE(inflw_plan_dt,rcpt_dt) DESC,inflw_id DESC
SELECT FROM fin.etc_inflw WHERE inflw_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT inflw_plan_dt AS planned_date,inflw_amt AS planned_amount,rcpt_dt AS actual_date, CASE WHEN rcpt_dt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE inflw_amt END AS actual_amount, CASE WHEN rcpt_dt IS NULL THEN inflw_amt ELSE 0 END AS remaining_amount,true AS inflow,inflw_se_cd AS category FROM fin.etc_inflw UNION ALL SELECT p.pay_plan_dt, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fin.pay child WHERE child.cry_pay_id=p.pay_id AND child.pay_stts_cd!='CANCEL') THEN COALESCE((SELECT sum(x.pay_amt) FROM fin.pay_execution x WHERE x.pay_id=p.pay_id),0) ELSE p.pay_amt END, NULL::date,0, CASE WHEN p.pay_stts_cd='PAID' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fin.pay child WHERE child.cry_pay_id=p.pay_id AND child.pay_stts_cd!='CANCEL') THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(p.pay_amt-COALESCE((SELECT sum(x.pay_amt) FROM fin.pay_execution x WHERE x.pay_id=p.pay_id),0),0) END,false,p.pay_se_cd FROM fin.pay p WHERE p.pay_stts_cd!='CANCEL' UNION ALL SELECT NULL::date,0,x.pay_dt,x.pay_amt,0,false,p.pay_se_cd FROM fin.pay_execution x JOIN fin.pay p ON p.pay_id=x.pay_id UNION ALL SELECT e.inout_dt,e.entry_amt+e.vat_amt, CASE WHEN e.inout_cmpl_yn='Y' THEN e.inout_dt END, CASE WHEN e.inout_cmpl_yn='Y' THEN e.entry_amt+e.vat_amt ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN e.inout_cmpl_yn='Y' THEN 0 ELSE e.entry_amt+e.vat_amt END,e.fin_se_cd='NOI',e.fin_se_cd FROM fin.entry e WHERE e.deleted_yn='N' AND e.inout_dt IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fin.pay p WHERE p.pay_src_cd='AUTO_FIN' AND p.src_rec_id=e.entry_id AND p.pay_se_cd IN ('SGA','ETC') AND p.pay_stts_cd!='CANCEL') UNION ALL SELECT t.pay_plan_dt,COALESCE(t.plan_amt,0),t.pay_dt,COALESCE(t.pay_amt,0), CASE WHEN t.pay_dt IS NULL THEN COALESCE(t.plan_amt,0) ELSE 0 END,false,'CORP_TAX' FROM fin.corp_tax_pay t WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fin.pay p WHERE p.pay_src_cd='AUTO_FIN' AND p.pay_se_cd='CORP_TAX' AND p.src_rec_id=t.tax_pay_id AND p.pay_stts_cd!='CANCEL') UNION ALL SELECT b.rcpt_plan_dt, b.tot_amt+COALESCE((SELECT sum(a.tot_amt) FROM bill.bill a WHERE a.orgnl_bill_id=b.bill_id AND a.amnd_yn='Y' AND a.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'),0), NULL::date,0, GREATEST(b.tot_amt+COALESCE((SELECT sum(a.tot_amt) FROM bill.bill a WHERE a.orgnl_bill_id=b.bill_id AND a.amnd_yn='Y' AND a.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'),0) -COALESCE((SELECT sum(r.rcpt_amt) FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=b.bill_id),0),0),true,'BILLING' FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.amnd_yn='N' AND b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'
